longDescription:
## Overview
Orion is an advanced AI-powered personal operating system embedded directly into my portfolio. It transforms a static portfolio into an intelligent, interactive interface capable of engaging visitors, answering contextual questions about my expertise, and automating real-world actions such as meeting scheduling.

---

## Problem
Traditional portfolios are static and cannot dynamically represent skills, availability, or context-aware insights. Recruiters and clients often need to manually navigate, email, or schedule calls through multiple steps.

---

## Solution
Orion provides conversational intelligence, real-time scheduling automation, contextual skill explanations, and executive-level insights via an admin intelligence layer.

---

## Technical Highlights
- Graph database powered memory retrieval instead of fixed message history
- Context selection engine to reduce token usage while increasing relevance
- Role-based access layer (Public vs Admin Orion)
- Secure OAuth-based authentication flow
- LLM orchestration with contextual memory injection

---

## Impact
Orion acts as a 24/7 AI representative, automating professional communication while maintaining personalization and context awareness.
skillNote: Intelligent AI operating system with graph memory, LLM orchestration, and scheduling automation

name: Nugget-O-Verse
description: A pedagogy-driven content engine powering structured, interactive learning experiences through atomic 'Nuggets' inside Physics Wallah's ecosystem.
longDescription:
# Nugget-O-Verse

## 🚀 Overview
Nugget-O-Verse is a pedagogy-driven learning engine designed to transform static educational content into structured, interactive, self-paced learning experiences.

Instead of treating education as a digital library of videos and PDFs, Nugget-O-Verse breaks content into atomic learning units called **Nuggets**, which can be dynamically assembled into meaningful learning flows called **Experiences**.

---

## 🧩 What is a Nugget?
A Nugget is the smallest consumable unit of learning content. It can be:

- Note
- Image
- Video
- Audio
- Single Choice Question (SCC)
- Multiple Choice Question (MCC)
- Fill in the Blanks (FIB)
- Label the Image (LTI)
- Subjective Question
- True/False
- Match the Column
- Table Nugget
- Scratch the Image

Each Nugget is:
- Tagged by category, subject, chapter, topic
- Configurable with XP rewards
- Configurable with Timers (multiples of 15 seconds)

---

## 🎯 Experience Engine
An **Experience** is a curated sequence of Nuggets designed to serve a learning objective.

Examples:
- Test Series (collection of question nuggets)
- Video Series
- Pedagogical Blend (video + note + question)
- Notes File (note + image nuggets)

This allows modular learning flow construction instead of static content consumption.

---

## 🏆 Gamification Layer
- XP points awarded for correct answers
- Timer-based reward scaling
- Structured engagement loops

XP values are configurable in multiples of 15.

---

## 🧠 Problem It Solves
Traditional schooling suffers from:
- One-size-fits-all pacing
- Lack of personalization
- Low engagement
- Memorization-based learning

Most EdTech apps act as digital libraries.

Nugget-O-Verse shifts the focus from content availability to **pedagogy-driven delivery**.

> Content can be pirated. Pedagogy cannot.

---

## 🏗 System Design Contribution
- Designed structured content schema for 13+ nugget types
- Built scalable question management backend
- Implemented XP and timer logic engine
- Created tag-based taxonomy for content filtering
- Enabled admin-based experience construction

---

## 💡 Impact
This system enables:
- Self-paced learning
- Structured engagement
- Interactive retention-driven content delivery
- Modular content scalability

Nugget-O-Verse lays the foundation for building pedagogy-first digital learning systems.
skillNote: Pedagogy-driven content engine, question management backend, gamification logic, Android Jetpack Compose UI

name: zkSpark IDO Launchpad
description: A Web3 IDO Launchpad built for Boosters Edutech, enabling token launches on Ethereum with smart contract interactions and wallet-based participation flows.
longDescription:
## Overview
zkSpark IDO Launchpad is a decentralized token launch platform built for Boosters Edutech, designed to facilitate Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs) on the Ethereum blockchain.

The platform allows projects to raise funds by offering tokens directly to participants through smart contract-enforced allocation and distribution logic — removing the need for centralized intermediaries.

---

## What is an IDO Launchpad?
An IDO (Initial DEX Offering) Launchpad is a platform where new crypto projects can launch their tokens to the public in a decentralized, permissionless manner.

Key mechanics:
- Projects register their token and set raise parameters
- Participants connect their wallets and commit funds
- Smart contracts handle allocation, vesting, and distribution
- Tokens are claimable post-launch directly on-chain

---

## zkSpark Test Token
To validate the launchpad end-to-end, a test token **zkSpark** was deployed on Ethereum testnet.

- Used to simulate a full IDO lifecycle: registration → contribution → distribution
- Verified smart contract interactions via ethers.js
- Tested wallet connection, transaction signing, and token claim flows with MetaMask

---

## Key Features
- Wallet connect flow (MetaMask / injected providers)
- Smart contract interaction via ethers.js
- Token contribution and allocation tracking
- On-chain token claim after IDO close
- Admin panel for project registration and IDO configuration

---

## System Design
- React.js frontend with wallet state management
- ethers.js for all contract reads and writes
- Solidity contracts for IDO logic, vesting schedules, and token distribution
- Testnet deployment for end-to-end validation before mainnet
skillNote: Web3 IDO Launchpad on Ethereum, ethers.js smart contract interactions, zkSpark test token on testnet
